Find scenes defined in a file or environment

Source: R/render_file.R
find_scenes.Rd

Sourcing a script runs its code, but calls of render(), render_file(), manim_cli(), preview_output() and manim_gadget() in it do nothing, so a script that ends with render(MyScene) is not rendered twice by render_file(), manim_cli() or the RStudio addins.

Usage

find_scenes(file = NULL, envir = NULL)

Arguments

file

Path to an R script defining scenes.

envir

Environment to search instead of a file.

Value

A named list of scene class generators, in definition order.
